description: This file contains type hinting and evaluation type inference functions for PySpark's pandas API integration, including handling of various UDF types and annotations.

methods.name: infer_pandas_eval_type
methods.description: Infers the pandas UDF evaluation type based on function signature and type hints.

methods.name: infer_arrow_eval_type
methods.description: Infers the arrow UDF evaluation type based on function signature and type hints.

methods.name: infer_eval_type
methods.description: Infers the overall evaluation type considering pandas and arrow UDFs based on signature and type hints.

methods.name: infer_eval_type_for_udf
methods.description: Infers the evaluation type for a given user-defined function.

methods.name: infer_group_arrow_eval_type
methods.description: Infers the group arrow UDF evaluation type based on function signature and type hints.

methods.name: infer_group_arrow_eval_type_from_func
methods.description: Infers group arrow evaluation type from a function object.

methods.name: infer_group_pandas_eval_type
methods.description: Infers the group pandas UDF evaluation type based on function signature and type hints.

methods.name: infer_group_pandas_eval_type_from_func
methods.description: Infers group pandas evaluation type from a function object.

methods.name: check_tuple_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is a Tuple type with optional element checks.

methods.name: check_iterator_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is an Iterator type with optional element checks.

methods.name: check_union_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is a Union type with optional element checks.
